observations.finding: The raw artifact won blind preference because full orbit inspection, dimensional construction, and less regular particles outweighed the Godagent artifact's stronger flame silhouette and polish.

The Godagent used constrained pointer tilt instead of direct orbit controls, injected a 2.73-times larger prompt, and required 44 percent more wall time while retaining a higher formal art-direction score.

proofLimits: one visual mission does not prove a recurring universal failure
the user verdict and coordinator audit are correlated views of the same paired artifact
the candidate remains experimental until fresh held-out missions are completed
